prompts.environment: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one clean painted environment plate for a portrait Unity World Map, based closely on the supplied reference's actual landscape composition. Output portrait 1024x1792 or closest portrait 9:16. Remove ALL UI, header, avatar, plaques, node discs, numbers, stars, dotted glowing path markers, buttons and bottom border. Reconstruct fully detailed uninterrupted scenery everywhere. Preserve the compositional landmarks: blue/gold onion-dome fortress in upper right around (68%,24%), warm misty mountains on horizon at 20%, birch tree at left, wood watchtower at (17%,33%), twisting blue stream down middle, richly detailed wooden village at lower left, huge carved wooden Slavic bearded idol at (84%,43%), small glowing sapphire shrine at (78%,59%), dense dark olive foliage and rocky paths. Keep a natural winding earth trail through the valley, but no UI dots, numbers or artificial markers. Warm late sunset highlights, cooler deep shadows, restrained saturated colors and darker lower foreground matching the approved Home. Full bleed coherent environment from top to bottom; no seams, mirrored bands, UI residue, characters, text or watermark. This is a new environment reconstruction from the reference, not a screenshot crop.
prompts.title: Reference input is a design guide only. Create an original, genuinely isolated game asset, never a rectangle cropped from the reference. Match its dimensional antique-gold filigree with bronze shadows, black/navy lacquer and sapphire accents, warm directional highlights, dark fairy-tale Russian luxury game art. No modern flat symbols. Use case: stylized-concept. One wide HORIZONTAL EMPTY TITLE PLAQUE, approximately 4.7:1 shape centered on a genuinely transparent RGBA background. Match the World Map title surround near the top of reference: elongated dark navy/black lacquer central text field with subtly carved texture, antique-gold sculptural flourishes around the edge, curled tendrils at sides, tiny sapphire accents, small palmette crest centered at top and small tapered gold pendant at bottom. Blank dark central area large enough for live text КАРТА МИРА, but render NO letters, words or symbols inside. Complete outer ornament visible with transparent margins. Opaque navy panel interior. Nothing else; no sky/scenery and no checkerboard painted in RGB. Render 1536x512 or closest wide format.
